observations.description: Explicit supervision and stop-control acknowledgements mandatory. Missing/false/non-boolean/int all reject with 'explicit owner'.
Evidence parsed through audited read_launch_evidence contract. Exact evidence_id and Git checkpoint preserved.

Confirmation created via OwnerSupervisionConfirmationV1.create: content-addressed (SHA-256), checkpoint-bound (evidence.repository_checkpoint), limit-bound (session 900s, commands 5, notional $100, gross $200), expires within 5 minutes.
Decision deterministic for identical evidence and as_of. Envelope identity=SHA-256(canonical body). Tamper-evident.
Atomic output via temp+os.replace. No temp files remaining after write.
Stale/unhealthy/dirty/not-running/gaps/unverified-drill/authority/future evidence all produce ineligible or reject. No unhealthy evidence can produce eligibility.
Hard limits: 15 minutes (900s), 5 commands, $100 notional, $200 gross. Constants enforced. Cannot be increased/bypassed/inferred.
Eligible: BTC-only, advisory_only=true, live_trading_permitted=false, trading_authority=false. No reasons when eligible. Has expires_at. Ineligible: no expires, no markets.
No network/credential/live/task-mutation/workflow-acquisition/gateway-execution imports. Only argparse, datetime, decimal, hashlib, json, os, pathlib, evidence_v1, gate_v1 used.
Direct function calls fail closed: naive as_of, non-UTC as_of, no supervision, malformed evidence all reject.
Envelope schema: DECISION_ENVELOPE_VERSION, decision_envelope_id SHA-256, launch_id SHA-256, confirmation_id SHA-256.
